CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2561 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0. Bus nonce: 2d373b9644063fc0264c41c109183ef2. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0` or `Fix review: blocked 2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2d373b9644063fc0264c41c109183ef2`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2561 2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2561-2d373b96`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2561 (R10-RCA-FRICTION, branch fix/r10-rca-harness-friction) at head 2aea7f08: the fixer's round 2 plus a main merge. Round 1 was blocked carry-missing (comment 6315535889; its mutation claims held, and only the routing and the body failed). Verify with the finder's harness, not the fixer's:
(1) Every Forward-carry item has a live owner. The groups R10-BRIEFS-FOLD, R10-POLICY-FIXER-MD and R10-POLICY-LINT-FAMILY on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (abca772ee or later) each cite #2561. Any dev/programme/carries/carry-N.json the PR adds matches carry_audit.py's schema. `python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body <body>` exits 0.
(2) The tools/policy/check-wave-script.mjs detector this PR lands: mutate it and show the tests fail; re-measure every body figure at this head.
(3) ## Red checks answers every red check-run at this head (nightly-status grades main); git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> is clean.
Standing rule 19: every observation ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>`, each ending (item <id>). Run carry_audit check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
